chunks.rationale: Start with electron/test/vibe-kanban.test.js. It builds both VK schemas (legacy git_repo_path/worktree_path and v2 repos/container_ref) and asserts the contract: detect db.v2 then db.sqlite, cards become threads with notes + first user message, latest attempt maps branch/PR/worktree only when the directory still exists, done settles, missing checkouts skip, re-import is a no-op on vibeKanbanTaskId, export omits settings. Then test/vibeKanbanSection.test.tsx for the Settings surface (found preview, disabled import, export path, section is mounted).
risks: Fixture DBs are a subset of the real migration chain. A later VK table rename (tasks → something else besides issues) would pass these tests and fail on a live db.
No live Electron dialog or real ~/Library/Application Support/ai.bloop.vibe-kanban was driven.

chunks.rationale: electron/vibeKanban.js is the whole feature. Read resolveSource/findDatabase (platform dirs + db.v2.sqlite preference), readSnapshot (PRAGMA-adaptive columns, UUID blobs), then importFrom (reuse project by path or vibeKanbanProjectId, createThread + patch, do not start a run, do not create a worktree, do not file GitHub issues). Idempotency is thread.vibeKanbanTaskId.
risks: A VK project with several repos keeps only the first repo path; sibling repos are dropped.
A leftover container_ref that still exists on disk is bound as worktreePath even if git no longer lists it as a worktree.
node:sqlite is experimental; a Node downgrade below 22 would break preview/import with a thrown error rather than a silent skip.

chunks.rationale: IPC + UI after the importer. electron/ipc.js vibeKanban:* handlers (preview, import broadcasts threads:changed, pickDataDir, export via save dialog). CoderApi in src/shared/ipc.ts, preload, wireClient, fakeCoder, devCoder. src/components/VibeKanbanSection.tsx in Settings under Your data. useCoder refreshes projects.list() on threads:changed so imported projects appear without a restart.
risks: threads:changed now also lists projects. Cheap, but a failed projects.list is swallowed and would leave a stale sidebar after an import that only added projects.
Web mode has no folder/save dialog; pick/export throw. The section still renders and Import is disabled until a preview finds a db, which web cannot do.

chunks.rationale: README feature bullet and site/docs.html paragraph under worktrees. They state the data dir, the mapping (cards → threads), and the JSON export. Read last.
risks: Site docs are the girder-deployed copy; this branch does not publish them.
Cards become Solenta threads, not GitHub planboard issues. Filing every VK card as a gh issue would spam the origin; existing PR numbers on attempts are mapped onto the thread instead.
Verification is the electron + renderer tests and tsc. The Settings modal was not driven in a live Electron window.
